remarks: Welcome to SoNo Lofts, one of South Norwalk's most desirable luxury condominium communities. This beautifully update one-bedroom residence was thoughtfully renovated in 2022 and offers a bright light-filled open floor plan with contemporary finishes throughout. The modern kitchen features stainless steel appliances, quartz countertops and a large island. The kitchen flows seamlessly into the living area, creating a perfect space for everyday living and entertaining. The spacious primary bedroom offers two generous closets and abundant natural light. The upgraded bathroom showcases a walk-in shower, while the convenient in-unit laundry closet adds everyday ease. Additional features include a fitness center, bike room, a locked storage unit, covered parking for one vehicle and elevator access. Ideally located in the heart of vibrant South Norwalk, you'll enjoy a walkable lifestyle with easy access to restaurants, shops, the waterfront, entertainment and The South Norwalk Train station. A perfect home for commuters, with approximately a 60-minute train ridge to New York City. Move-in ready and perfectly updated, this exceptional condo combines luxury, convenience and location. Make your appointment today!
